decisions.reason: Restricting the permitted source to Teyron's content does not change the existing requirement to select strong, high-quality moments from the permitted source.
The source-content restriction does not change the independently applicable clean editing-style standard.

The candidate already records the source message's changes to the trial qualification method and clip count; specifying Teyron's content concerns clip source selection and does not necessarily alter qualification state.
The permitted source for trial clips does not change the leadership pathway, base-salary structure, or team-management responsibility.
